snippet.title: Psycho-Sleuth OUT NOW | Solve all mysteries before the killer becomes a God!
snippet.description:
Psycho-sleuth is officially out now! The base game is $19.99, with 10% OFF for the first 14 days after launch~

13 contestants. Each afflicted by a different cognitive disorder. And every condition can spread to others.
One cannot lie. Another's mind erases everything to their left. Another cannot recognize any human face.
When the murderer strikes under these rules, when every witness's perception is compromised, the truth remains buried beneath illusion.
Can you still uncover the truth?

The game includes:
40 CGs | Dozens of 3D backgrounds | 500,000-word script | Live2D for all 13 characters | 50+ original BGM tracks | 10,000+ lines of Japanese voice acting

Steam Store: [https://store.steampowered.com/app/3432860/PsychoSleuth/]

Thank you to all the players who have supported us all along! The team has decided to keep the free Demo available on the store page~
Thank you again to everyone willing to step into the world of Psycho-sleuth. We hope you enjoy the game~

#PsychoSleuth #mysterygame  #deduction  #VisualNovel  #LaunchPV
